messages.author: 2c21699eecac9408
messages.subject: Re: Reactive error
parts:
The problem is in your switch statements. As inputs change over time, Shiny forces you to only use them in reactive expressions or observers, which in turn means that you'll always be using the most recent data unless you put guards against that. You have to wrap your switch statements in reactive({}) : 

                   data <- reactive({switch(input$parameters,
                   "University Classes" = classes$Type                    
                     )})


Read up on reactivity if you haven't already and can spare the time: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/reactivity-overview.html
